content.short: Mantle is an advanced decentralized protocol designed for seamless layer 2 blockchains within the Web3 ecosystem on Ethereum.
content.description: Mantle is a high-performance Ethereum layer-2 network built with modular architecture. Built organically for the Web3 ecosystem, Mantle provides an essential suite of services focused heavily on layer 2 blockchains. By operating on Ethereum, it allows users to experience fast execution times while maintaining strong cryptographic security. The protocol is designed to be highly interoperable, aiming to become a cornerstone of the Blockchains sector. Through continuous innovation, Mantle contributes to the broader vision of a decentralized, permissionless digital economy.
content.meta: Mantle is redefining layer 2 blockchains on Ethereum. Dive into detailed analytics and explore Mantle directly on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
